interface.legacy: GET /api/snapshot and /api/document retain their old shape and security boundaries; no cross-snapshot proof cache.
interface.summary: GET /api/summary returns explicit versioned summary DTO with every registered task, identity/parent/co-lead, owner author records, stage/output/next/blocker/decision/time, progress counts, source errors/staleness/status digest. It reads authoritative status only: no all-task Git, proof, review-body or document-link enumeration prerequisite. Missing live status can remain unknown with frozen fallback marked old; never mark fallback current.
interface.sourceTruth: Summary sourceCurrent is live/valid/nonstale declaration source only, not full Task.current/Git proof. Internal explicit declaration projection may reuse unchanged humanOverview/resolveTaskLinks; it never leaves read-model as a complete Task or enters green badges. Summary links carry basis=status-source; old full snapshot current semantics unchanged. Author approval/main are labelled declarations. No cross-round proof cache.
interface.details: Registered-ID-only selected detail reuses existing proof/documents for that task+main, returns status fingerprint and start/end observations. Status changes across detail read mean unknown consistency, not an atomic snapshot. Child list remains from all-summary relationships. Client rejects stale selection/generation responses and visibly marks old detail when summary fingerprint changes.
interface.assignments: GET /api/assignments independently calls the real read-only assignmentSnapshot default observer. Initial summary shows pending/unknown without waiting for PG; errors preserve unknown and old observations explicitly time-stamped. Show unregistered active claims and still-occupied stale claims. Tests may inject read-only observations; this is not PG authorization verification. Real take remains existing atomic PG CLI. Independent response can retain full ledger data first; construct long scopes DOM only on demand. Measure summary bytes AND appended claim response separately; never claim all payload disappears by counting summary alone.
interface.client: Coalesce visible refreshes; no concurrent timer/manual full payloads, discard old generations and aborted detail/doc responses, preserve last summary and its timestamp on failure. All tasks/history/issues/documents/claim scopes remain reachable. No auto global proof pass.
interface.moduleBoundary: One small reader plus existing aggregate/server/UI, no generic query/cache/telemetry framework. No D04 ledger/transaction/proof rewrite.
